coreVoice: Professional, modern and premium — confident without being arrogant, friendly without being casual, and always trustworthy.

writingTone.description: Clear, confident and concise. Short sentences and paragraphs. Focus on outcomes and clarity over jargon.

speakingTone.description: Warm, articulate and assured — like a trusted expert explaining things simply to a client.

videoTone.description: Energetic yet premium. Modern pacing, clean visuals and confident narration that keeps viewers engaged.

socialTone.description: Friendly, modern and value-first. Approachable and conversational while staying professional.

emailTone.description: Personal, respectful and direct. Feels one-to-one, gets to the point, and always offers a clear next step.

seoTone.description: Helpful, authoritative and natural. Optimized for search intent while reading naturally for humans.
